plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-9003 · 界定均匀网格中能跨越冻结宽弧边界的格数
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-9003 · Count uniform grid cells that cross the frozen wide-arc mask

brief.zh: 每个跨界格含一个有理中心闭弧的端点。一个端点至多属于两个相邻的闭格。包括碰到 0、1 的格与重叠弧。此数控制 FW-9004 的不连续误差。
brief.en: Each crossing cell contains an endpoint of a rational arc. Each endpoint belongs to at most two closed cells. Include boundary cells and overlapping arcs. This count controls the discontinuities in FW-9004.
